arxiv-1702-07011.title: How Software Developers Mitigate Collaboration Friction with Chatbots
arxiv-1702-07011.creator: Carlene Lebeuf Alexey Zagalsky Margaret-Anne Storey
arxiv-1702-07011.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Carlene Lebeuf Alexey Zagalsky Margaret-Anne Storey. Modern software developers rely on an extensive set of social media tools and communication channels. The adoption of team communication platforms has led to the emergence of conversation-based tools and integrations, many of which are chatbots. Understanding how software developers manage their complex constellation of collaborators in conjunction with the practices and tools they use can bring valuable insights into socio-technical collaborative work in software development and other knowledge work domains.

arxiv-2204-02069.title: Mirror symmetry on levels of non-abelian Landau–Ginzburg orbifolds
arxiv-2204-02069.creator: Wolfgang Ebeling, Sabir M. Gusein-Zade
arxiv-2204-02069.description: Abstract We consider the Berglund–Hübsch–Henningson–Takahashi duality of Landau–Ginzburg orbifolds with a symmetry group generated by some diagonal symmetries and some permutations of variables. We study the orbifold Euler characteristics, the orbifold monodromy zeta functions and the orbifold E-functions of such dual pairs.

arxiv-2405-12881.title: Explaining Expert Search and Team Formation Systems with ExES
arxiv-2405-12881.creator: Kiarash Golzadeh, Lukasz Golab, Jaroslaw Szlichta
arxiv-2405-12881.description: Abstract . Expert search and team formation systems operate on collaboration networks, with nodes representing individuals, labeled with their skills, and edges denoting collaboration relationships. Given a keyword query corresponding to the desired skills, these systems identify experts that best match the query. However, state-of-the-art solutions to this problem lack transparency.

arxiv-2407-09388.description: Abstract Automatically generating novel and interesting games is a complex task. Challenges include representing game rules in a computationally workable form, searching through the large space of potential games under most such representations, and accurately evaluating the originality and quality of previously unseen games.

arxiv-2502-00800.title: Adversarial Semantic Augmentation for Training Generative Adversarial Networks under Limited Data
arxiv-2502-00800.creator: Mengping Yang, Zhe Wang, Ziqiu Chi, Dongdong Li, Wenli Du
arxiv-2502-00800.description: Abstract Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have made remarkable achievements in synthesizing images in recent years. Typically, training GANs requires massive data, and the performance of GANs deteriorates significantly when training data is limited. To improve the synthesis performance of GANs in low-data regimes, existing approaches use various data augmentation techniques to enlarge the training sets.

pmc-11399391.creator: Changpeng Chai, Huan Tang, Xin Miao, Tingting Chen, Yuanhui Su, Lu Li, Long Miao, Bo Zhang, Zhengfeng Wang, Wei Luo, Hui Zhang, Hao Xu, Wence Zhou
pmc-11399391.description: In this study, we successfully established a novel gallbladder cancer cell line, designated as GBC-X1, derived from a primary tumor of a gallbladder cancer patient. pmc-12681736.title: Salmonella encodes murein lipoproteins differing in the anchoring to peptidoglycan and intermolecular association
pmc-12681736.creator: Marcos Peñalver, Juan J Cestero, Alberto Paradela, Felipe Cava, Francisco García-del Portillo
pmc-12681736.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Graphical abstractKeywords: Murein lipoprotein, Salmonella, Peptidoglycan, Disulphide bridge

Introduction

A prominent feature of the cell envelope of Gram-negative bacteria is the presence of an outer membrane rich in proteins and lipopolysaccharides (Silhavy et al., 2010).The stability of this envelope depends on the physical connection of the outer membrane to the peptidoglycan (PG) layer, a role played by specialized proteins like Braun's lipoprotein (Lpp).

pmc-13200240.title: Total Chemical Synthesis of the Human Milk Oligosaccharide Disialyllacto‑N‑tetraose and Its Degradation by Bifidobacterium bifidum Sialidases
pmc-13200240.creator: Maiko Tanase, Aruto Nakajima, Naoko Komura, Hidenori Tanaka, Hiromune Ando, Hideharu Ishida, Takane Katayama, Toshihiko Katoh, Akihiro Imamura
pmc-13200240.description: Disialyllacto-N-tetraose (DSLNT), a human milk oligosaccharide implicated in neonatal immunity and necrotizing enterocolitis prevention, contains both Neu5Acα(2→3)­Gal and Neu5Acα(2→6)­GlcNAc motifs. Its synthesis is hindered by challenging α-sialylation. Here we report the total chemical synthesis of DSLNT via simultaneous double sialylation using macrobicyclic donors, achieving complete stereocontrol. A convergent [4 + 2] glycosylation enabled efficient assembly.

pmc-13236278.title: Early post-traumatic avascular necrosis with secondary osteoarthritis following an acetabular fracture in a 19-year-old patient treated with total hip arthroplasty: a case report
pmc-13236278.creator: Hamza Khaiata, Osman Desho, Ahmad Abdul Hakim Alhamid, Mostafa Sagheer, Yaman Jamal Qoudra Danial
pmc-13236278.description: Introduction and importance:Acetabular fractures are complex orthopedic injuries that can lead to severe long-term complications, including avascular necrosis (AVN) of the femoral head and secondary osteoarthritis. These sequelae may result in progressive joint destruction and may ultimately require total hip arthroplasty (THA), particularly in cases where joint preservation is no longer feasible.

pmc-13400758.creator: Tung Viet Cao, Thuy Minh Ha, Ly Ha Pham, Khiem Van Nguyen
pmc-13400758.description: Allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis (ABPA) is under-recognized in children with refractory asthma and may be obscured by concurrent respiratory infections. We describe a 10-year-old girl with poorly controlled asthma admitted with fever, productive cough, and wheezing. Investigations revealed marked peripheral eosinophilia (1.48 × 10⁹/L), markedly elevated total immunoglobulin E (1742 IU/mL), positive bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) galactomannan, and positive BAL Aspergillus antigen.

pmc-13477330.title: HIF1α Attenuates Doxorubicin‐Induced Cardiotoxicity by Activating TEX264‐Associated ER‐phagy
pmc-13477330.creator: Xinying Wang, Ge Zhan, Jiatian Li, Xinmiao Yang, Yuhang Wen, Yuqi Tang, Puyu Zhang, Yunlong Xia, Xiaolei Yang
pmc-13477330.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe clinical utility of doxorubicin, a potent chemotherapeutic agent, is severely limited by its dose‐dependent cardiotoxicity. Hypoxia‐inducible factor 1α (HIF1α) is a key regulator of cardiovascular adaptation, but its role and mechanism in doxorubicin‐induced cardiotoxicity (DIC) remain unclear.MethodsUsing in vitro (AC16 cells) and in vivo (mouse) models of DIC, we used genetic (knockout, knockdown) and pharmacological (FG4592) approaches to modulate HIF1α. Cardiac function, apoptosis, endoplasmic reticulum (ER) morphology, and ER‐phagy flux were assessed.

pmc-13618858.title: Dual mechanism of human ATG10S in suppressing MEF2A-Driven pro-inflammatory responses
pmc-13618858.creator: Miao-Qing Zhang, Zheng-Hao Wang, Jing-Pu Zhang
pmc-13618858.description: Cytokine storm, characterized by excessive release of pro-inflammatory cytokines, contributes to the severity and exacerbation of various diseases. Current therapies targeting individual cytokines prove inadequate due to the complex and multifactorial nature of inflammatory cascades. Here, we report human ATG10S, a novel isoform of the autophagy-related protein ATG10, as a potential inhibitor of cytokine storms.
